affinity.description: Pod affinity configuration. Can be templated

args.description: Overrides the default args for the Keycloak container

command.description: Overrides the default entrypoint of the Keycloak container

enableServiceLinks.description: Indicates whether information about services should be injected into Pod's environment variables, matching the syntax of Docker links

extraContainers.description: Additional sidecar containers, e. g. for a database proxy, such as Google's cloudsql-proxy

extraEnv.description: Additional environment variables for Keycloak. Values can be templated

extraEnvFrom.description: Additional environment variables for Keycloak mapped from a Secret or ConfigMap. Values can be templated

extraInitContainers.description: Additional init containers, e. g. for providing custom themes

extraPorts.description: Add additional ports, e. g. for admin console or exposing JGroups ports

extraVolumeMounts.description: Add additional volumes mounts, e. g. for custom themes. Values can be templated

extraVolumes.description: Add additional volumes, e. g. for custom themes. Values can be templated

fullnameOverride.description: Optionally override the fully qualified name

hostAliases.description: Mapping between IPs and hostnames that will be injected as entries in the Pod's hosts files

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets for the Pod

enabled.description: If true, an Ingress is created

ingressClassName.description: The name of the Ingress Class associated with the ingress

pathType.description: Path Type for the Ingress rule

servicePort.description: The Service port targeted by the Ingress

enabled.description: If true, an Ingress for the console is created

rules.description: List of Ingress rules for the console

host.description: Host for the Ingress rule for the console

paths.description: Paths for the Ingress rule for the console

path.description: Path for the Ingress rule for the console

pathType.description: Path Type for the Ingress rule for the console

ingressClassName.description: The name of the Ingress Class associated with the console ingress

hosts.description: List of TLS hosts for console ingress

secretName.description: Name of the TLS secret for console ingress

lifecycleHooks.description: Lifecycle hooks for the Keycloak container

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe configuration for checking if the container is alive

image.description: Docker image used to check PostgreSQL readiness at startup

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the pgchecker container

podDisruptionBudget.description: Pod disruption budget configuration to ensure high availability during cluster updates

podManagementPolicy.description: Pod management policy. One of `Parallel` or `OrderedReady`

updateStrategy.description: StatefulSet update strategy. One of `RollingUpdate` or `OnDelete`

podSecurityContext.description: SecurityContext for the entire Pod. Every container running in the Pod will inherit this SecurityContext. This might be relevant when other components of the environment inject additional containers into running Pods (service meshes are the most prominent example for this)

enabled.description: If true, the PostgreSQL dependency is enabled

postgresqlPassword.description: PostgreSQL Password for the new user

enabled.description: If true, a PrometheusRule resource for the prometheus-operator is created
If true, a ServiceMonitor resource for the prometheus-operator is created

namespace.description: Optionally sets a target namespace in which to deploy the ServiceMonitor resource

namespaceSelector.description: Optionally sets a namespace selector for the ServiceMonitor

interval.description: Interval at which Prometheus scrapes metrics

path.description: The path at which metrics are served

port.description: The Service port at which metrics are served

extraServiceMonitor.description: Additional ServiceMonitor configuration for the prometheus-operator

enabled.description: If true, an additional ServiceMonitor resource for the prometheus-operator is created

namespace.description: Optionally sets a target namespace in which to deploy the additional ServiceMonitor resource

namespaceSelector.description: Optionally sets a namespace selector for the additional ServiceMonitor

labels.description: Additional labels for the additional ServiceMonitor

interval.description: Interval at which Prometheus scrapes metrics

path.description: The path at which metrics are served

port.description: The Service port at which metrics are served

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe configuration for checking if the container is ready to handle requests

replicas.description: The number of replicas to create

restartPolicy.description: Pod restart policy. One of `Always`, `OnFailure`, or `Never`

enabled.description: If true, an OpenShift Route is created

insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy.description: Insecure edge termination policy of the Route. Can be None, Redirect, or Allow

termination.description: TLS termination of the route. Can be edge, passthrough, or reencrypt

secrets.description: Configuration for secrets that should be created

annotations.description: Annotations for headless and HTTP Services

extraPorts.description: Additional Service ports, e. g. for custom admin console

loadBalancerSourceRanges.description: Optional List of allowed source ranges (CIDRs). Used for service of type LoadBalancer only

httpNodePort.description: The HTTP Service node port if type is NodePort

httpsNodePort.description: The HTTPS Service node port if type is NodePort

httpManagementNodePort.description: The WildFly management node port if type is NodePort

labels.description: Additional labels for headless and HTTP Services

loadBalancerIP.description: Optional IP for the load balancer. Used for services of type LoadBalancer only

externalTrafficPolicy.description: Optional external traffic policy. Used for services of type LoadBalancer only

create.description: Specifies whether a ServiceAccount should be created

imagePullSecrets.description: Image pull secrets that are attached to the ServiceAccount

name.description: The name of the service account to use. If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template

create.description: Specifies whether RBAC resources are to be created

rules.description: Custom RBAC rules, e. g. for KUBE_PING

startupScripts.description: Startup scripts to run before Keycloak starts up

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Termination grace period in seconds for Keycloak shutdown. Clusters with a large cache might need to extend this to give Infinispan more time to rebalance

enabled.description: Enable creation of a HorizontalPodAutoscaler resource

labels.description: Additional labels for the HorizontalPodAutoscaler resource

minReplicas.description: The minimum number of Pods when autoscaling is enabled

maxReplicas.description: The maximum number of Pods when autoscaling is enabled

metrics.description: The metrics configuration for the HorizontalPodAutoscaler

behavior.description: The scaling policy configuration for the HorizontalPodAutoscaler

enabled.description: If true, the ingress network policy is deployed

extraFrom.description: Allows to define allowed external traffic

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints for pod distribution across your cluster among failure-domains

skipInitContainers.description: Skip all init containers (to avoid issues with service meshes which require sidecar proxies for connectivity)

startupProbe.description: Startup probe configuration for checking when the application within the container has started

path.description: HTTP path to check for application startup

port.description: Port to use for startup probe checks

initialDelaySeconds.description: Initial delay before startup probe begins

failureThreshold.description: Number of times the probe can fail before giving up

periodSeconds.description: How often to perform the startup probe

enabled.description: If true, test resources are created

image.description: The image configuration for the test Pod

podSecurityContext.description: SecurityContext for the entire test Pod
